text:
Alex K.: morning async — quick infra standup for GPU fleet / quotas (what i did / blockers / today)
Alex K.: what I did: deprovisioned 4 p4d nodes in eu-west-1 to consolidate low-util hosts; baseline utilization ~42% across hosted pool. noticed KV-cache hit rate improved after cleaning old sessions.
Priya R.: blocker: us-west-2 EC2 G5 quota is at 90% — quota increase request #3482 submitted but AWS asked for workload justification. This is blocking the Dedicated reserve for a customer ramp next week.
Miguel S.: FYI I opened quota requests for us-west-2 and ap-southeast-1 this morning. AWS flagged p5 instances and wants cost/throughput numbers; asked sales for expected TPS + model sizes.
Alex K.: we need a short justification doc. Miguel, can you paste the perf numbers? Also can we temporarily borrow capacity from hosted pool to cover the Dedicated reservation?
Miguel S.: perf snapshot: 16 tokens/sec per p4d for long context runs, p5 estimate ~30 tokens/sec. I'll paste a short table in the ticket.
Priya R.: provisional plan: autoscale bump + transient reserve. command to create reservation locally:
```
rb pool reserve --region=us-west-2 --count=8 --type=p4d --ttl=7d --purpose="dedicated ramp"
```
Use with care — will reduce available hosted capacity.
infra-bot: Alert: node group g4dn-eu has 2/8 healthy instances (maintenance in progress). Affected jobs are being drained.
Sam (oncall): I'll reassign capacity from staging to hosted for the next 24h window. Ping me @Sam if anything needs immediate move. ETA on quota approval looks ~36h per AWS console.
Alex K.: today I will: 1) finalize the reserve if we get approval, 2) update the capacity dashboard with the p4d/p5 splits, 3) publish a short runbook for manual borrow + rollback.
Miguel S.: I'll add the throughput justification to ticket #3482 and drop the doc link here once done.
Priya R.: small note — quotas for ap-southeast-1 are fine but limits for specific instance families differ; check family-specific quota in the console.
Alex K.: thanks all. If staging borrow looks safe Sam, let's schedule the `rb pool reserve` for tonight 22:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
Priya R.: noted. I'll also add a monitoring alert for utilization >85% post-reserve.
Miguel S.: will follow up with sales and AWS contact.
Alex K.: closing loop: will post an update here after running the reserve or on any quota changes.
